title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Terms: Returning Registry Gifts
content:
**A. Who may return.** The registrant of a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry can return a gift that a guest bought from the registry — a purchase record linked to this registry — without a receipt; the registry gift record is the proof.

**B. Deadline.** The return is authorized no later than the registry gift return deadline counted from the event date. That deadline is the later of (i) the event date plus the registry type's registry gift return window in calendar days and (ii) the ordinary return deadline of the gift's merchandise class, counted from the date the guest's purchase was completed. A return authorized on the deadline is in time. The event date is the one on the registry record of the registry the gift is linked to.

**C. Condition, method, fees and credit.** The return follows the class's condition, method and fee rules, and is credited to the registry as registry credit equal to the price the guest paid, less any fee the class rules deduct, never to the guest's tender or in cash; the registrant may instead exchange it for another item.
*Status: no longer in force for a registry gift return whose registry credit is booked once the store has received the registrant's return, in so far as it sets the credited amount by the class's fee rules; for such a return the class's condition and method rules still apply, the credit still goes to the registry as registry credit and never to the guest's tender or in cash, and the registrant may still exchange the gift for another item. Every other return of a registry gift remains under this clause.*

**D. One credit per return.** No registry credit has already been booked for the same return record; the registry's entries are the evidence.

**E. Completion purchases.** A gift the registrant bought with the completion discount is the registrant's own purchase and is refunded under the ordinary order rules.

## Deadline cases (hypothetical dates)

Registry type window of 90 calendar days; event date 1 June.

| Ordinary class deadline of the gift | Registry deadline | Governing deadline | Return authorized | In time? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 July | 30 August | 30 August | 30 August | yes |
| 15 July | 30 August | 30 August | 31 August | no |
| 15 September | 30 August | 15 September | 15 September | yes |
| 15 September | 30 August | 15 September | 16 September | no |

## Basis Q&A

**Does the registrant need the guest's receipt?** No; the registry gift record is the proof.

**A registrant returns an item she bought herself at the completion discount — is it a registry gift return?** No; it is her own purchase and is refunded under the ordinary order rules.
